assay: bulk RNA-seq, mouse ventral hippocampus (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, 101 bp PE; STAR GRCm39 + salmon; TMM+CPM via conorm per GEO data_processing)
sample_inclusion: male C57BL/6J mice; GEO lists 9 samples: SED (non-stressed sedentary, n=3), SUS (chronic-restraint-stress susceptible, sedentary, n=3), SUS+LE (stress-susceptible + low-intensity treadmill exercise below VT, n=3); single batch
primary_estimand: Effect of low-intensity treadmill exercise on the ventral-hippocampal transcriptome of stress-susceptible mice (SUS+LE vs SUS); secondary: stress-susceptibility effect (SUS vs SED)
planned_contrasts: SUSLE vs SUS (abstract: 'transcriptomic profiling of vHPC showed this adaptive state was associated with coordinated modulation of primary cilium-associated gene networks'; DEG count not stated in abstract)
SUS vs SED (stress effect; implied by GEO overall design, count not stated)
paper_method: not stated in the abstract or GEO record
paper_results: abstract names no DEG counts or genes; reports reduced IL-1a (Il1a) and fractalkine (Cx3cl1) expression after low-intensity exercise (measurement assay unspecified)
